title: git_check misses ~/.gitignore_global and identity links that git_install creates
body: git_check tests only ~/.gitconfig, but git_install also links ~/.gitignore_global and every config/git/gitconfig_* identity (~/.gitconfig_<handle>). A break in either passes the check, so install never runs and resleeve reports git ok. Found 2026-09-15 during the ~/Devel/cfg move: on both rhadamanth and gyges, ~/.gitignore_global was a regular file (rhadamanth's dated 24 Aug) instead of the link to Molt-matts, and differed from it (no *.sql; Icon\r\r instead of Icon?). Nothing reported it until the move broke ~/.gitconfig and install ran, backing the file up. This is the check-covers-fewer-targets-than-install class the CHANGELOG already records for zsh and vscode. Fix: git_check and git_verify cover every target git_install links, with a test that breaks each one.
